ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with approximately 25-30% high-intensity (white/light grey) patches localized primarily on the distal regions and inner trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Diffuse, high-contrast white mottling concentrated on the outer third of the right lobe; discrete, smaller white/grey pixel clusters scattered across the outer half of the left lobe; dark pixels dominate the central and lower visible surface area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged boundary with high-amplitude serrations; left lobe exhibits roughly 7-9 prominent triangular peaks; right lobe exhibits roughly 6-8 prominent peaks; inter-peak valleys are deep and predominantly V-shaped.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper visible margins leading to acute, uplifted tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of multi-tonal, roughly circular pixel groups (white and tan) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of light-colored, textured clusters (barnacles) on lobe tips; highly irregular, potentially traumatized trailing edge topography with deep jagged notches.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the height and frequency of serrations between the left and right lobe trailing edges.
